pokedex.249: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.
pokedex.250: Legends claim this POKéMON flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent seven- colored wings.
pokedex.251: This POKéMON wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.
pokedex.252: TREECKO has small hooks on the bottom of its feet that enable it to scale vertical walls. This POKéMON attacks by slamming foes with its thick tail.
pokedex.253: The leaves growing out of GROVYLE’s body are convenient for camouflaging it from enemies in the forest. This POKéMON is a master at climbing trees in jungles.
pokedex.254: The leaves growing on SCEPTILE’s body are very sharp edged. This POKéMON is very agile - it leaps all over the branches of trees and jumps on its foe from above or behind.
pokedex.255: TORCHIC sticks with its TRAINER, following behind with unsteady steps. This POKéMON breathes fire of over 1,800 degrees F, including fireballs that leave the foe scorched black.
pokedex.256: COMBUSKEN toughens up its legs and thighs by running through fields and mountains. This POKéMON’s legs possess both speed and power, enabling it to dole out ten kicks in one second.
pokedex.257: In battle, BLAZIKEN blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously. The stronger the foe, the more intensely this POKéMON’s wrists burn.
pokedex.258: The fin on MUDKIP’s head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this POKéMON can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.
pokedex.259: The surface of MARSHTOMP’s body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This POKéMON plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.
pokedex.260: SWAMPERT is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This POKéMON also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.
pokedex.261: At first sight, POOCHYENA takes a bite at anything that moves. This POKéMON chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.
pokedex.262: MIGHTYENA gives obvious signals when it is preparing to attack. It starts to growl deeply and then flattens its body. This POKéMON will bite savagely with its sharply pointed fangs.
pokedex.263: ZIGZAGOON restlessly wanders everywhere at all times. This POKéMON does so because it is very curious. It becomes interested in anything that it happens to see.
pokedex.264: LINOONE always runs full speed and only in straight lines. If facing an obstacle, it makes a right-angle turn to evade it. This POKéMON is very challenged by gently curving roads.
pokedex.265: Using the spikes on its rear end, WURMPLE peels the bark off trees and feeds on the sap that oozes out. This POKéMON’s feet are tipped with suction pads that allow it to cling to glass without slipping.
pokedex.266: SILCOON tethers itself to a tree branch using silk to keep from falling. There, this POKéMON hangs quietly while it awaits evolution. It peers out of the silk cocoon through a small hole.
pokedex.267: BEAUTIFLY’s favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this POKéMON, just leave a potted flower by an open window. BEAUTIFLY is sure to come looking for pollen.
pokedex.268: CASCOON makes its protective cocoon by wrapping its body entirely with a fine silk from its mouth. Once the silk goes around its body, it hardens. This POKéMON prepares for its evolution inside the cocoon.
pokedex.269: DUSTOX is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms of this POKéMON are attracted by the bright lights of cities, where they wreak havoc by stripping the leaves off roadside trees for food.
pokedex.270: LOTAD live in ponds and lakes, where they float on the surface. It grows weak if its broad leaf dies. On rare occasions, this POKéMON travels on land in search of clean water.
pokedex.271: LOMBRE is nocturnal - it will get active after dusk. It is also a mischief-maker. When this POKéMON spots anglers, it tugs on their fishing lines from beneath the surface and enjoys their consternation.
pokedex.272: LUDICOLO begins dancing as soon as it hears cheerful, festive music. This POKéMON is said to appear when it hears the singing of children on hiking outings.
pokedex.273: SEEDOT attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. It sucks moisture from the tree while hanging off the branch. The more water it drinks, the glossier this POKéMON’s body becomes.
pokedex.274: NUZLEAF live in densely overgrown forests. They occasionally venture out of the forest to startle people. This POKéMON dislikes having its long nose pinched.
pokedex.275: SHIFTRY is a mysterious POKéMON that is said to live atop towering trees dating back over a thousand years. It creates terrific windstorms with the fans it holds.
pokedex.276: TAILLOW courageously stands its ground against foes, however strong they may be. This gutsy POKéMON will remain defiant even after a loss. On the other hand, it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.
pokedex.277: SWELLOW flies high above our heads, making graceful arcs in the sky. This POKéMON dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. The hapless prey is tightly grasped by SWELLOW’s clawed feet, preventing escape.
pokedex.278: Its hollow bones enhance its lightness. It spreads its wings to the wind and soars away into the sky.
pokedex.279: Its spacious beak is large enough for a small child to fit right inside.
pokedex.280: RALTS senses the emotions of people using the horns on its head. This POKéMON rarely appears before people. But when it does, it draws closer if it senses that the person has a positive disposition.
pokedex.281: It is said that a KIRLIA that is exposed to the positive emotions of its TRAINER grows beautiful. This POKéMON controls psychokinetic powers with its highly developed brain.
pokedex.282: GARDEVOIR has the ability to read the future. If it senses impending danger to its TRAINER, this POKéMON is said to unleash its psychokinetic energy at full power.
pokedex.283: It moves as if skating on the surface of the water. It often fights with Dewpider over food.
pokedex.284: It intimidates enemies with the eye-like patterns on its antennae. Its four wings allow it to fly in any direction.
pokedex.285: SHROOMISH live in damp soil in the dark depths of forests. They are often found keeping still under fallen leaves. This POKéMON feeds on compost that is made up of fallen, rotted leaves.
pokedex.286: BRELOOM closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms. This POKéMON’s fighting technique puts boxers to shame.
pokedex.287: SLAKOTH lolls around for over twenty hours every day. Because it moves so little, it does not need much food. This POKéMON’s sole daily meal consists of just three leaves.
pokedex.288: VIGOROTH is always itching and agitated to go on a wild rampage. It simply can’t tolerate sitting still for even a minute. This POKéMON’s stress level rises if it can’t be moving constantly.
pokedex.289: SLAKING spends all day lying down and lolling about. It eats grass growing within its reach. If it eats all the grass it can reach, this POKéMON reluctantly moves to another spot.
pokedex.290: NINCADA lives underground for many years in complete darkness. This POKéMON absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees. It stays motionless as it waits for evolution.
pokedex.291: NINJASK moves around at such a high speed that it cannot be seen, even while its crying can be clearly heard. For that reason, this POKéMON was long believed to be invisible.
pokedex.292: SHEDINJA’s hard body doesn’t move - not even a twitch. In fact, its body appears to be merely a hollow shell. It is believed that this POKéMON will steal the spirit of anyone peering into its hollow body from its back.
pokedex.293: Normally, WHISMUR’s voice is very quiet - it is barely audible even if one is paying close attention. However, if this POKéMON senses danger, it starts crying at an earsplitting volume.
pokedex.294: LOUDRED’s bellowing can completely decimate a wood-frame house. It uses its voice to punish its foes. This POKéMON’s round ears serve as loudspeakers.
pokedex.295: EXPLOUD triggers earthquakes with the tremors it creates by bellowing. If this POKéMON violently inhales from the ports on its body, it’s a sign that it is preparing to let loose a huge bellow.
pokedex.296: It was originally brought in from another region, but now Makuhita from Alola are more famous.
pokedex.297: It is known for its fantastic strength, but as it grows older, it focuses more on training Makuhita.
pokedex.298: AZURILL spins its tail as if it were a lasso, then hurls it far. The momentum of the throw sends its body flying, too. Using this unique action, one of these POKéMON managed to hurl itself a record 33 feet.
pokedex.299: The magnet in Nosepass’s nose provides an unerring compass, making it an excellent partner for Trainers going on a journey.
pokedex.300: SKITTY has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This POKéMON is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.
pokedex.301: DELCATTY prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this POKéMON eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.
pokedex.302: It’s a fiend for gemstones, so it stalks Carbink. Unfortunately, Gabite almost always grabs them first.
pokedex.303: A cunning and terrifying Pokémon, its cuteness makes opponents let down their guard—and then it swallows them whole with its huge jaws.
pokedex.304: This POKéMON has a body of steel. To make its body, ARON feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.
pokedex.305: LAIRON tempers its steel body by drinking highly nutritious mineral springwater until it is bloated. This POKéMON makes its nest close to springs of delicious water.
pokedex.306: AGGRON claims an entire mountain as its own territory. It mercilessly beats up anything that violates its environment. This POKéMON vigilantly patrols its territory at all times.
pokedex.307: MEDITITE undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this POKéMON always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.
pokedex.308: It is said that through meditation, MEDICHAM heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This POKéMON hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.
pokedex.309: Friction between the air and its fur produces static electricity. When Electrike runs, it makes a crackling sound.
pokedex.310: Manectric can be found beneath unnatural thunderclouds. People say it can run at the same speed as lightning striking.
pokedex.311: PLUSLE always acts as a cheerleader for its partners. Whenever a teammate puts out a good effort in battle, this POKéMON shorts out its body to create the crackling noises of sparks to show its joy.
pokedex.312: MINUN is more concerned about cheering on its partners than its own safety. It shorts out the electricity in its body to create brilliant showers of sparks to cheer on its teammates.
pokedex.313: With the arrival of night, VOLBEAT emits light from its tail. It communicates with others by adjusting the intensity and flashing of its light. This POKéMON is attracted by the sweet aroma of ILLUMISE.
pokedex.314: ILLUMISE attracts a swarm of VOLBEAT using a sweet fragrance. Once the VOLBEAT have gathered, this POKéMON leads the lit-up swarm in drawing geometric designs on the canvas of the night sky.
pokedex.315: ROSELIA shoots sharp thorns as projectiles at any opponent that tries to steal the flowers on its arms. The aroma of this POKéMON brings serenity to living things.
pokedex.316: Virtually all of GULPIN’s body is its stomach. As a result, it can swallow something its own size. This POKéMON’s stomach contains a special fluid that digests anything.
pokedex.317: When SWALOT spots prey, it spurts out a hideously toxic fluid from its pores and sprays the target. Once the prey has weakened, this POKéMON gulps it down whole with its cavernous mouth.
pokedex.318: Each school has its own territory. Any intruders are mercilessly attacked with fangs bared.
pokedex.319: It pursues its prey at speeds of 75 mph and finishes them off with fangs that can crush iron. It is known as the bully of the sea.
pokedex.320: It loves to startle people. It fills itself up with seawater and plays by bouncing around like a ball.
pokedex.321: Wailord pursue their prey in pods. With their large mouths, they can swallow entire schools of Wishiwashi whole.
pokedex.322: NUMEL is extremely dull witted - it doesn’t notice being hit. However, it can’t stand hunger for even a second. This POKéMON’s body is a seething cauldron of boiling magma.
pokedex.323: CAMERUPT has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees F courses through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this POKéMON’s back erupt, spewing the superheated magma.
pokedex.324: Coal is the source of Torkoal’s energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mountains where they live.
pokedex.325: SPOINK bounces around on its tail. The shock of its bouncing makes its heart pump. As a result, this POKéMON cannot afford to stop bouncing - if it stops, its heart will stop.
pokedex.326: GRUMPIG uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power waves for gaining total control over its foe. When this POKéMON uses its special power, its snorting breath grows labored.
pokedex.327: Its steps are staggering and unsteady, but Spinda thinks it’s walking in a straight line.
pokedex.328: It can live for a week without eating a thing. It waits patiently at the bottom of its nest for prey to appear.
pokedex.329: Rather than using its underdeveloped wings for flight, it rubs them together, producing ultrasonic waves to attack its enemies.
pokedex.330: The flapping of its wings sounds something like singing. Those lured by the sound are enveloped in a sandstorm, becoming Flygon’s prey.
pokedex.331: CACNEA lives in arid locations such as deserts. It releases a strong aroma from its flower to attract prey. When prey comes near, this POKéMON shoots sharp thorns from its body to bring the victim down.
pokedex.332: During the daytime, CACTURNE remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun. This POKéMON becomes active at night when the temperature drops.
pokedex.333: SWABLU has light and fluffy wings that are like cottony clouds. This POKéMON is not frightened of people. It lands on the heads of people and sits there like a cotton-fluff hat.
pokedex.334: ALTARIA dances and wheels through the sky among billowing, cotton-like clouds. By singing melodies in its crystal-clear voice, this POKéMON makes its listeners experience dreamy wonderment.
pokedex.335: Memories of battling its arch-rival SEVIPER are etched into every cell of ZANGOOSE’s body. This POKéMON adroitly dodges attacks with incredible agility.
pokedex.336: SEVIPER shares a generations-long feud with ZANGOOSE. The scars on its body are evidence of vicious battles. This POKéMON attacks using its sword- edged tail.
pokedex.337: LUNATONE was discovered at a location where a meteorite fell. As a result, some people theorize that this POKéMON came from space. However, no one has been able to prove this theory so far.
pokedex.338: SOLROCK is a new species of POKéMON that is said to have fallen from space. It floats in air and moves silently. In battle, this POKéMON releases intensely bright light.
pokedex.339: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey’s location.
pokedex.340: A glutton that devours anything that moves, it quietly lurks at the bottom of swamps, lying in wait for prey.
pokedex.341: Individuals that have been set free by Trainers who could no longer raise them have become common, and they can now be found in Alola.
pokedex.342: Its temperament is rough and it loves to fight, but as soon as its pincers break off, it turns cowardly. It stays timid until they grow back.
pokedex.343: Depictions of Pokémon similar to Baltoy have been found on the walls of caves where primitive humans lived.
pokedex.344: If it gets wet, its body melts. When rain starts to fall, it wraps its whole body up with its psychic powers to protect itself.
pokedex.345: In ancient times, it lived in warm seas. It disguised itself as seaweed to ambush its prey and devoured them whole when they got close.
pokedex.346: Normally, it lived on shallow sea shoals. When the tide went out, this Pokémon came up on land to search for prey.
pokedex.347: When restored Anorith are released into the ocean, they don’t thrive, because the water composition has changed since their era.
pokedex.348: It lived on land and went out into the sea to hunt for prey. Its sharp claws were its greatest weapon.
pokedex.349: A tough Pokémon that is perfectly fine even in dirty water. However, due to its ragged, shabby appearance, it isn’t popular.
pokedex.350: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.
pokedex.351: It changes its form depending on the weather. Changes in the temperature or humidity appear to affect its cellular structure.
pokedex.352: It changes its hue to blend into its surroundings. If no one takes notice of it for too long, it will pout and never reveal itself.
pokedex.353: It eats up emotions like malice, jealousy, and resentment, so some people are grateful for its presence.
pokedex.354: It’s a stuffed toy that was thrown away and became possessed, ever searching for the one who threw it away so it can exact its revenge.
pokedex.355: DUSKULL can pass through any wall no matter how thick it may be. Once this POKéMON chooses a target, it will doggedly pursue the intended victim until the break of dawn.
pokedex.356: DUSCLOPS’s body is completely hollow - there is nothing at all inside. It is said that its body is like a black hole. This POKéMON will absorb anything into its body, but nothing will ever come back out.
pokedex.357: The bunches of fruit growing around the necks of Tropius in Alola are especially sweet compared to those in other regions.
pokedex.358: CHIMECHO makes its cries echo inside its hollow body. When this POKéMON becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves that have the power to knock foes flying.
pokedex.359: Long ago, superstitions were spread about it, saying it brought disaster. This fed a hatred of it, and it was driven deep into the mountains.
pokedex.360: WYNAUT can always be seen with a big, happy smile on its face. Look at its tail to determine if it is angry. When angered, this POKéMON will be slapping the ground with its tail.
pokedex.361: Their numbers seem to have rapidly increased in Alola. Custom has it that houses where Snorunt live will be prosperous for generations to come.
pokedex.362: Legend says a boulder on an icy mountain absorbed the distress and regrets of a stranded mountaineer, giving rise to Glalie.
pokedex.363: SPHEAL is much faster rolling than walking to get around. When groups of this POKéMON eat, they all clap at once to show their pleasure. Because of this, their mealtimes are noisy.
pokedex.364: SEALEO has the habit of always juggling on the tip of its nose anything it sees for the first time. This POKéMON occasionally entertains itself by balancing and rolling a SPHEAL on its nose.
pokedex.365: WALREIN’s two massively developed tusks can totally shatter blocks of ice weighing ten tons with one blow. This POKéMON’s thick coat of blubber insulates it from subzero temperatures.
pokedex.366: Despite its appearance, it’s carnivorous. It clamps down on its prey with both sides of its shell and doesn’t let go until they stop moving.
pokedex.367: It’s not the strongest swimmer. It wags its tail to lure in its prey and then gulps them down as soon as they get close.
pokedex.368: The color of its body changes with the water temperature. The coloration of Gorebyss in Alola is almost blindingly vivid.
pokedex.369: Its form has remained the same for one hundred million years. Its body is filled with fat, so it can withstand the water pressure of the deep sea.
pokedex.370: If a Luvdisc is left on its own, it becomes despondent, leaving itself open to attack. That is when Pelipper snatch them up.
pokedex.371: Its belief that it will be able to fly one day is apparently the influence of information carried in its genes.
pokedex.372: The cells within its shell transform with explosive speed, preparing it for evolution.
pokedex.373: When angered, it loses all sense of itself and destroys everything around it. The destruction will continue until Salamence has tired itself out.
pokedex.374: Its cells are all magnets. It uses magnetism to communicate with others of its kind.
pokedex.375: When two Beldum link together, their psychic power is doubled. Their intelligence, however, remains unchanged.
pokedex.376: It firmly pins its prey using its four claws and large body. Then the teeth in the mouth on its stomach chew the prey to bits.
pokedex.377: REGIROCK was sealed away by people long ago. If this POKéMON’s body is damaged in battle, it is said to seek out suitable rocks on its own to repair itself.
pokedex.378: REGICE’s body was made during an ice age. The deep-frozen body can’t be melted, even by fire. This POKéMON controls frigid air of minus 328 degrees F.
pokedex.379: REGISTEEL has a body that is harder than any kind of metal. Its body is apparently hollow. No one has any idea what this POKéMON eats.
pokedex.380: LATIAS is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this POKéMON ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.
pokedex.381: LATIOS has the ability to make its foe see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This POKéMON is intelligent and understands human speech.
pokedex.382: KYOGRE has the power to create massive rain clouds that cover the entire sky and bring about torrential downpours. This POKéMON saved people who were suffering from droughts.
pokedex.383: GROUDON has long been described in mythology as the POKéMON that raised lands and expanded continents. This POKéMON took to sleep after a cataclysmic battle with KYOGRE.
pokedex.384: RAYQUAZA lived for hundreds of millions of years in the earth’s ozone layer, never descending to the ground. This POKéMON appears to feed on water and particles in the atmosphere.
pokedex.385: A legend states that JIRACHI will make true any wish that is written on notes attached to its head when it awakens. If this POKéMON senses danger, it will fight without awakening.
pokedex.386: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in DEOXYS. The crystalline organ on this POKéMON’s chest appears to be its brain.
pokedex.387: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.
pokedex.388: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
pokedex.389: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.
pokedex.390: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.
pokedex.391: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.
pokedex.392: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.
pokedex.393: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.
pokedex.394: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
pokedex.395: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.
pokedex.396: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
pokedex.397: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.
pokedex.398: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.
pokedex.399: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
pokedex.400: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.
pokedex.401: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.
pokedex.402: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.
pokedex.403: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
pokedex.404: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.
pokedex.405: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.
pokedex.406: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.
pokedex.407: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.
pokedex.408: It lived in jungles around a hundred million years ago. It used its skillful headbutts to combat Aerodactyl.
pokedex.409: The result of repeated headbutts is a skull grown thick and hard. However, its brain has shrunk in size compared with Cranidos’s.
pokedex.410: Many fossils of this Pokémon have been found, but almost none have shown signs of damage to the face.
pokedex.411: While it can guard against any sort of attack from the front, it is left without recourse when attacked from behind.
pokedex.412: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
pokedex.413: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.
pokedex.414: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.
pokedex.415: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.
pokedex.416: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.
pokedex.417: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
pokedex.418: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.
pokedex.419: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
pokedex.420: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.
pokedex.421: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.
pokedex.422: For the most part, it makes its home along the seashore. Its color and form differ according to its habitat and the quality of its food.
pokedex.423: It has strong regenerative capabilities. Even if parts of it are bitten off by fish Pokémon, it will return to normal within a few hours.
pokedex.424: In their search for comfortable trees, they get into territorial disputes with groups of Passimian. They win about half the time.
pokedex.425: Stories go that it grabs the hands of small children and drags them away to the afterlife. It dislikes heavy children.
pokedex.426: There was once an incident in which a man took a trip riding a Drifblim, only to go missing.
pokedex.427: Its arms and legs are weak, but when it rolls its ears up tight and then unleashes them with its full force, it can smash boulders to dust.
pokedex.428: Lopunny regrows its coat twice a year. Mufflers and hats made from its fur are really warm.
pokedex.429: It appears as if from nowhere—muttering incantations, placing curses, and giving people terrifying visions.
pokedex.430: A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and more than a hundred of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.
pokedex.431: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
pokedex.432: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.
pokedex.433: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.
pokedex.434: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.
pokedex.435: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
pokedex.436: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.
pokedex.437: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.
pokedex.438: It does not deal well with water, so it lives in dry locales. Since its surroundings tend to lack greenery, it stands out noticeably.
pokedex.439: It does its absolute best to mimic the movements and expressions of its opponents, but it’s still not very good at it.
pokedex.440: It carries a round white rock in its belly pouch. If it gets along well with someone, it will sometimes give that person the rock.
pokedex.441: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.
pokedex.442: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.
pokedex.443: It lives in caves warmed by geothermal heat. Even so, when the weather gets cold, it will huddle close with others of its kind.
pokedex.444: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.
pokedex.445: It can fly at speeds rivaling jet planes. It dives into flocks of bird Pokémon and gulps the entire flock down whole.
pokedex.446: It needs to consume its own weight in food every day. As far as flavor is concerned, it’s indifferent.
pokedex.447: It can discern the physical and emotional states of people, Pokémon, and other natural things from the shape of their aura waves.
pokedex.448: Not only does it perceive auras, but it has also gained the power to control them. It employs them in battle.
pokedex.449: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.
pokedex.450: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.
pokedex.451: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
pokedex.452: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.
pokedex.453: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.
pokedex.454: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.
pokedex.455: It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
pokedex.456: It absorbs sunlight with the pink areas of its skin, which then shine. This appears to be a form of camouflage.
pokedex.457: With its shining light, it lures its prey close. However, the light also happens to attract ferocious fish Pokémon—its natural predators.
pokedex.458: It’s highly friendly and easily tamed. Tours that take people swimming with Mantyke are a super-popular beach activity.
pokedex.459: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.
pokedex.460: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.
pokedex.461: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.
pokedex.462: Three units generate magnetism. There have been many mistaken reports of UFO sightings when Magnezone flies through the night sky.
pokedex.463: A contest is under way to determine which one can stick its tongue out the farthest. The current record is...more than 82 feet.
pokedex.464: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. GEODUDE are shot at rare times.
pokedex.465: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.
pokedex.466: It pushes the tips of its tails against its foes and then lets loose a high-voltage current. Its foes are burned to a crisp in an instant.
pokedex.467: They dwell in volcanic craters. According to what is known, a single pair of male and female Magmortar lives in one volcano.
pokedex.468: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.
pokedex.469: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.
pokedex.470: Its cellular composition is closer to that of a plant than an animal. It uses photosynthesis to produce its energy supply without eating food.
pokedex.471: It can control its body temperature at will. This enables it to freeze the moisture in the atmosphere, creating flurries of diamond dust.
pokedex.472: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
pokedex.473: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.
pokedex.474: In order to create a more advanced Pokémon, an additional program was installed, but apparently it contained a defect that makes it move oddly.
pokedex.475: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.
pokedex.476: It radiates such a powerful magnetic field that nearby electrical appliances become unusable.
pokedex.477: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.
pokedex.478: When it finds humans or Pokémon it likes, it freezes them and takes them to its chilly den, where they become decorations.
pokedex.479: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.
pokedex.480: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
pokedex.481: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
pokedex.482: Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
pokedex.483: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.
pokedex.484: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.
pokedex.485: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
pokedex.486: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.
pokedex.487: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.
pokedex.488: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
pokedex.489: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.
pokedex.490: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.
pokedex.491: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.
pokedex.492: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.
pokedex.493: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.
pokedex.494: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
pokedex.495: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.
pokedex.496: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.
pokedex.497: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.
pokedex.498: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
pokedex.499: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.
pokedex.500: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.
pokedex.501: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.
pokedex.502: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
pokedex.503: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.
pokedex.504: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.
pokedex.505: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.
pokedex.506: Because it doesn’t yelp, it’s extremely popular with Trainers who live in apartment buildings.
pokedex.507: Its dense black fur grows continuously. The high cost of keeping its hard fur properly groomed makes this a troublesome Pokémon to train.
pokedex.508: Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant, it’s a trustworthy partner on rescue teams.
pokedex.509: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.
pokedex.510: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.
pokedex.511: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.
pokedex.512: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
pokedex.513: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.
pokedex.514: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.
pokedex.515: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
pokedex.516: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.
pokedex.517: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.
pokedex.518: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.
pokedex.519: Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.
pokedex.520: It can return to its Trainer’s location regardless of the distance separating them.
pokedex.521: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.
pokedex.522: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.
pokedex.523: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
pokedex.524: Born deep within the ground, it compares itself with similar species, such as Geodude and Carbink, to settle which has the hardest body.
pokedex.525: Its orange crystal is a mass of energy. Just one crystal fragment would provide enough fuel for a hundred dump trucks.
pokedex.526: The blasts of energy it makes from sunbeams have terrifying power. However, it’s not able to fire its blasts at night or on rainy days.
pokedex.527: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
pokedex.528: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.
pokedex.529: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.
pokedex.530: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
pokedex.531: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.
pokedex.532: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.
pokedex.533: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
pokedex.534: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
pokedex.535: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.
pokedex.536: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
pokedex.537: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.
pokedex.538: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
pokedex.539: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.
pokedex.540: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.
pokedex.541: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
pokedex.542: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.
pokedex.543: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.
pokedex.544: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
pokedex.545: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.
pokedex.546: When it finds others of its kind, they all stick together. When enough of them have collected, the mass resembles a cumulonimbus cloud.
pokedex.547: It rides on the wind and slips into people’s homes. After it has turned a room into a cotton- filled mess, it giggles to itself and takes off.
pokedex.548: Although the leaves on its head are bitter enough to cause dizziness, they provide relief from weariness—even more so when boiled.
pokedex.549: No matter how much time and money is spent raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when they bloom in the wild.
pokedex.550: Savage, violent Pokémon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.
pokedex.551: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.
pokedex.552: They move in groups of a few individuals. A female is often the leader of the group, and the males will gather food.
pokedex.553: Its unique faculty of sight can detect small prey more than 30 miles away, even in the midst of a sandstorm.
pokedex.554: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.
pokedex.555: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
pokedex.556: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
pokedex.557: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.
pokedex.558: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.
pokedex.559: They move in small groups, walking around lazily. Anyone who makes eye contact gets smacked with a headbutt.
pokedex.560: This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.
pokedex.561: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.
pokedex.562: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.
pokedex.563: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
pokedex.564: Based on studies of its skeletal structure, it can apparently dive to ocean depths of over half a mile.
pokedex.565: It constructed its sturdy shell by crunching and swallowing the hard shells or bones of its prey.
pokedex.566: It is the ancestor of all bird Pokémon. Archen itself could not actually fly but moved by hopping from treetop to treetop.
pokedex.567: Although apparently able to fly, they tended to run along the ground, averaging speeds of roughly 25 mph.
pokedex.568: Unsanitary places are what they like best. They can be spotted in Alola, often with Grimer in hot pursuit.
pokedex.569: Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots from its right arm. If even a little of it gets on you, you’ll experience the effects of the unidentified toxin.
pokedex.570: This Pokémon has a cowardly disposition, so when it’s not around friends, it basically always stays transformed as something else.
pokedex.571: It doesn’t just transform itself—it also has the power to make hundreds of people see its illusions.
pokedex.572: A clean freak that will not allow even the slightest mess, it uses its tail like a mop to thoroughly clean any and all filth.
pokedex.573: The white parts of its coat are covered in an oil secreted from its body, so this Pokémon can slide right away from its enemies’ attacks.
pokedex.574: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
pokedex.575: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.
pokedex.576: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.
pokedex.577: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.
pokedex.578: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.
pokedex.579: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.
pokedex.580: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.
pokedex.581: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
pokedex.582: Born of an icicle, this Pokémon uses its frosty breath to make ice crystals, causing snow to fall.
pokedex.583: Hot days cause its body to melt. It can be restored by refreezing it, but the process leaves its body slightly warped.
pokedex.584: Each of its two heads has a brain, and when they are in agreement, it attacks its enemies by exhaling a violent blizzard.
pokedex.585: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.
pokedex.586: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.
pokedex.587: It glides using its cape-like membrane. Electrical energy scatters from it, shocking its friends and foes alike.
pokedex.588: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
pokedex.589: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.
pokedex.590: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.
pokedex.591: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.
pokedex.592: It wraps its veillike arms and legs around prey swimming by and drags them down to the depths of the ocean.
pokedex.593: Jellicent is always hanging around fancy cruise ships and tankers, hoping to drag away its prey.
pokedex.594: It uses its special mucus to close the wounds of injured Pokémon. The reason for this behavior remains unknown.
pokedex.595: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.
pokedex.596: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.
pokedex.597: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.
pokedex.598: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.
pokedex.599: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.
pokedex.600: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.
pokedex.601: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.
pokedex.602: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
pokedex.603: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.
pokedex.604: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.
pokedex.605: It controls tremendous psychic power. Most reports of alien sightings are actually just people mistaking Elgyem for an alien.
pokedex.606: With its psychic powers, it rewrites its opponents’ memories. You, too, may have already had your memories rewritten.
pokedex.607: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.
pokedex.608: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.
pokedex.609: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.
pokedex.610: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.
pokedex.611: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they’ve been fighting.
pokedex.612: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.
pokedex.613: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.
pokedex.614: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.
pokedex.615: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.
pokedex.616: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.
pokedex.617: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.
pokedex.618: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.
pokedex.619: They can often be seen in packs in the morning, slowly moving their bodies through a series of poses.
pokedex.620: It overwhelms its opponents with continuous attacks and then slowly stores up power before delivering the finishing blow.
pokedex.621: The red skin on its face is harder than rock. In narrow caves, it squares off against its enemies and charges face-first right into them.
pokedex.622: Its movements are powered by a mysterious energy. It has continued to move since ancient times, so its power may soon run out.
pokedex.623: Some say that ancient people invented Golurk to serve as a laborer. It follows its master’s orders faithfully.
pokedex.624: After shredding its prey, it sharpens its blades on a stone by the river. Each Pawniard has its own favorite sharpening stone.
pokedex.625: No matter how strong the Bisharp, it’s said that if the blade on its head is chipped, it will retire from its position as the boss.
pokedex.626: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
pokedex.627: They pick fights indiscriminately. They grow stronger and more powerful each time they faint or are injured.
pokedex.628: With its brave disposition, it fears nothing—not even death. Ancient Alolan people respected it, referring to it as “the hero of the sky.”
pokedex.629: It protects its plump posterior with the bones of prey it has consumed. As it grows, it replaces the bones.
pokedex.630: They adorn themselves beautifully with bones. This is supposedly an effort to attract males, but no male Mandibuzz have ever been found.
pokedex.631: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.
pokedex.632: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.
pokedex.633: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.
pokedex.634: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.
pokedex.635: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.
pokedex.636: When battling opponents, it sprays fire from its five horns. The max temperature of the flames can reach nearly 5,500 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokedex.637: As it flies, it scatters its flaming scales. It was feared by ancient people, who referred to it as “the rage of the sun.”
pokedex.638: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.
pokedex.639: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.
pokedex.640: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.
pokedex.641: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.
pokedex.642: Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.
pokedex.643: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.
pokedex.644: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.
pokedex.645: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”
pokedex.646: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.
pokedex.647: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.
pokedex.648: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.
pokedex.649: Over 300 million years ago, it was feared as the strongest of hunters. It has been modified by Team Plasma.
pokedex.650: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
pokedex.651: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’ attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.
pokedex.652: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.
pokedex.653: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokedex.654: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.
pokedex.655: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.
pokedex.656: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.
pokedex.657: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
pokedex.658: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
pokedex.659: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
pokedex.660: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.
pokedex.661: This amiable Pokémon is easy to train. But when battle is joined, it shows its ferocious side.
pokedex.662: From its beak, it fires embers at its prey. Once it has caught them, it grills them at high heat before feasting upon them.
pokedex.663: Its favorite foods are Wingull and Pikipek. It attacks with a powerful kick and grasps them firmly in its talons.
pokedex.664: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.
pokedex.665: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
pokedex.666: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.
pokedex.667: When they’re young, they live with a pride. Once they’re able to hunt prey on their own, they’re kicked out and have to make their own way.
pokedex.668: The males are usually lazy, but when attacked by a strong foe, a male will protect its friends with no regard for its own safety.
pokedex.669: It’s not safe without the power of a flower, but it will keep traveling around until it finds one with the color and shape it wants.
pokedex.670: It raises flowers and uses them as weapons. The more gorgeous the blossom, the more power it contains.
pokedex.671: It controls the flowers it grows. The petal blizzards that Florges triggers are overwhelming in their beauty and power.
pokedex.672: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
pokedex.673: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.
pokedex.674: It grows up imitating the behavior of Pangoro, which it looks up to as a leader.
pokedex.675: It boasts superb physical strength. Those who wish to become Pangoro’s Trainer have no choice but to converse with their fists.
pokedex.676: There was an era when aristocrats would compete to see who could trim their Furfrou’s fur into the most exquisite style.
pokedex.677: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
pokedex.678: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
pokedex.679: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.
pokedex.680: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.
pokedex.681: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.
pokedex.682: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.
pokedex.683: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.
pokedex.684: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.
pokedex.685: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.
pokedex.686: It draws prey near with its blinking lights and then wraps them up in its long tentacles and holds them in place.
pokedex.687: When it comes to strong hypnosis, there’s an endless number of people who utilize Malamar for their nefarious deeds.
pokedex.688: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.
pokedex.689: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.
pokedex.690: It vanishes into seaweed and remains perfectly still to avoid attacks from large Pokémon. Rotten seaweed is its main food source.
pokedex.691: This vicious Pokémon sprays a poisonous liquid on opponents that come near. For whatever reason, it gets along really well with Dhelmise.
pokedex.692: Its claws occasionally fall off, and it keeps a low profile until they grow back. The meat of its claws is so delicious!
pokedex.693: It compresses the water it has sucked up and then projects it with enough power to punch a hole right through a thick sheet of iron.
pokedex.694: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.
pokedex.695: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.
pokedex.696: Its large jaw has incredible destructive power. Some theories suggest that its restored form is different from its form of long ago.
pokedex.697: Complete restoration is impossible, allowing room for theories that its entire body was once covered in a feather-like coat.
pokedex.698: It lived in cold areas in ancient times. It’s said that when Amaura whinnies, auroras appear in the night sky.
pokedex.699: An Aurorus was found frozen solid within a glacier, just as it appeared long ago, which became quite a big event in the news.
pokedex.700: Its ribbonlike feelers give off an aura that weakens hostility in its prey, causing them to let down their guard. Then it attacks.
pokedex.701: It overwhelms opponents with quick moves, but sometimes it showboats for too long when it’s using a special move and gets itself into a pinch.
pokedex.702: It sneaks into people’s homes and steals electricity from their outlets. When your electric bill seems off, it’s the handiwork of this rascal.
pokedex.703: Born from the high temperatures and pressures deep underground, it defends itself by firing beams from the jewel part of its body.
pokedex.704: The weakest of all Dragon-type Pokémon, it’s unable to breathe if its skin dries out, so it sticks to shady places.
pokedex.705: It has trouble drawing a line between friends and food. It will calmly try to melt and eat even those it gets along well with.
pokedex.706: An amazingly friendly Pokémon, but if left to itself, loneliness overcomes it, and it oozes gooey tears.
pokedex.707: This even-tempered Pokémon has a habit of collecting keys. It will sneak into people’s homes to steal their keys.
pokedex.708: These Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died in the forest. Their cries sound like eerie screams.
pokedex.709: This Pokémon is said to devour anyone daring to ravage the forest. To the creatures dwelling in the forest, it offers great kindness.
pokedex.710: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.
pokedex.711: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.
pokedex.712: It blocks opponents’ attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.
pokedex.713: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.
pokedex.714: Fruits are its favorite foods. This gourmet carefully picks out just the ripe ones using its sonar.
pokedex.715: Although it has a violent disposition, if you give it a nice ripe fruit that it loves, Noivern will suddenly become tame.
pokedex.716: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.
pokedex.717: When this legendary Pokémon’s wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.
pokedex.718: This is Zygarde’s form when it has gathered 50% of its cells. It wipes out all those who oppose it, showing not a shred of mercy.
pokedex.719: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.
pokedex.720: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.
pokedex.721: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It’s said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.
pokedex.722: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.
pokedex.723: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.
pokedex.724: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.
pokedex.725: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.
pokedex.726: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.
pokedex.727: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it’s not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer’s orders with complete nonchalance.
pokedex.728: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It’s famous for being a hard worker.
pokedex.729: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards its enemies.
pokedex.730: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.
pokedex.731: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.
pokedex.732: It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak. When it encounters enemies or prey, it fires off all the seeds in a burst.
pokedex.733: When it battles, its beak heats up. The temperature can easily exceed 212 degrees Fahrenheit, causing severe burns when it hits.
pokedex.734: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.
pokedex.735: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it’s always snoozing by nightfall.
pokedex.736: Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.
pokedex.737: Its body is capable of storing electricity. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.
pokedex.738: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.
pokedex.739: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.
pokedex.740: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.
pokedex.741: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.
pokedex.742: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it’s able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.
pokedex.743: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.
pokedex.744: It’s considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.
pokedex.745: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.
pokedex.746: When it’s in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.
pokedex.747: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.
pokedex.748: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.
pokedex.749: The mud stuck to Mudbray’s hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.
pokedex.750: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.
pokedex.751: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.
pokedex.752: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.
pokedex.753: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. When night falls, it walks around looking for a safer place to sleep.
pokedex.754: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis’s vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.
pokedex.755: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.
pokedex.756: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.
pokedex.757: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.
pokedex.758: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.
pokedex.759: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.
pokedex.760: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.
pokedex.761: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.
pokedex.762: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.
pokedex.763: Its long, striking legs aren’t just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.
pokedex.764: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.
pokedex.765: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it’s best suited to veteran Trainers.
pokedex.766: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.
pokedex.767: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.
pokedex.768: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.
pokedex.769: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.
pokedex.770: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.
pokedex.771: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.
pokedex.772: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.
pokedex.773: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokémon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.
pokedex.774: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.
pokedex.775: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.
pokedex.776: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.
pokedex.777: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.
pokedex.778: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.
pokedex.779: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.
pokedex.780: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.
pokedex.781: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.
pokedex.782: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.
pokedex.783: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.
pokedex.784: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.
pokedex.785: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.
pokedex.786: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.
pokedex.787: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.
pokedex.788: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.
pokedex.789: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.
pokedex.790: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.
pokedex.791: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.
pokedex.792: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.
pokedex.793: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.
pokedex.794: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.
pokedex.795: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.
pokedex.796: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.
pokedex.797: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.
pokedex.798: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.
pokedex.799: It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. It’s one of the Ultra Beasts.
pokedex.800: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.
pokedex.801: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.
pokedex.802: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.
pokedex.803: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.
pokedex.804: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.
pokedex.805: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.
pokedex.806: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It’s apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.
pokedex.807: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they’ll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

moves.pound: The target is physically pounded with a long tail, a foreleg, or the like.
moves.scratch: Hard, pointed, sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.
moves.teleport: Use it to flee from any wild Pokémon.
moves.night-shade: The user makes the target see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.
moves.mimic: The user copies the target’s last move. The move can be used during battle until the Pokémon is switched out.
moves.screech: An earsplitting screech harshly lowers the target’s Defense stat.
moves.double-team: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.
moves.recover: Restoring its own cells, the user restores its own HP by half of its max HP.
moves.harden: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.
moves.minimize: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller, which sharply raises its evasiveness.
moves.smokescreen: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. This lowers the target’s accuracy.
moves.confuse-ray: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.
moves.vice-grip: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.
moves.withdraw: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, raising its Defense stat.
moves.defense-curl: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.
moves.barrier: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.
moves.light-screen: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special attacks for five turns.
moves.haze: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.
moves.reflect: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical attacks for five turns.
moves.focus-energy: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.
moves.bide: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.
moves.metronome: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.
moves.mirror-move: The user counters the target by mimicking the target’s last move.
moves.guillotine: A vicious, tearing attack with big pincers. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.
moves.self-destruct: The user attacks everything around it by causing an explosion. The user faints upon using this move.
moves.egg-bomb: A large egg is hurled at the target with maximum force to inflict damage.
moves.lick: The target is licked with a long tongue, causing damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.smog: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. This may also poison the target.
moves.sludge: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may also poison the target.
moves.bone-club: The user clubs the target with a bone. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.fire-blast: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.waterfall: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.
moves.clamp: The target is clamped and squeezed by the user’s very thick and sturdy shell for four to five turns.
moves.swift: Star-shaped rays are shot at the opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.
moves.razor-wind: In this two-turn attack, blades of wind hit opposing Pokémon on the second turn. Critical hits land more easily.
moves.skull-bash: The user tucks in its head to raise its Defense stat on the first turn, then rams the target on the next turn.
moves.spike-cannon: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.
moves.constrict: The target is attacked with long, creeping tentacles, vines, or the like. This may also lower the target’s Speed stat.
moves.amnesia: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.
