moves.kinesis: The user distracts the target by bending a spoon. This lowers the target’s accuracy.
moves.soft-boiled: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its max HP.
moves.high-jump-kick: The target is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If it misses, the user is hurt instead.
moves.glare: The user intimidates the target with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.
moves.dream-eater: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal its own HP.
moves.poison-gas: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the face of opposing Pokémon, poisoning those hit.
moves.swords-dance: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.
moves.barrage: Round objects are hurled at the target to strike two to five times in a row.
moves.leech-life: The user drains the target’s blood. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
moves.lovely-kiss: With a scary face, the user tries to force a kiss on the target. If it succeeds, the target falls asleep.
moves.sky-attack: A second-turn attack move where critical hits land more easily. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.transform: The user transforms into a copy of the target right down to having the same move set.
moves.bubble: A spray of countless bubbles is jetted at the opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their Speed stat.
moves.dizzy-punch: The target is hit with rhythmically launched punches. This may also leave the target confused.
moves.spore: The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.
moves.flash: The user flashes a bright light that cuts the target’s accuracy.
moves.psywave: The target is attacked with an odd psychic wave. The attack varies in intensity.
moves.cut: The target is cut with a scythe or claw.
moves.splash: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...
moves.acid-armor: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply raising its Defense stat.
moves.crabhammer: The target is hammered with a large pincer. Critical hits land more easily.
moves.explosion: The user attacks everything around it by causing a tremendous explosion. The user faints upon using this move.
moves.fury-swipes: The target is raked with sharp claws or scythes quickly two to five times in a row.
moves.bonemerang: The user throws the bone it holds. The bone loops around to hit the target twice—coming and going.
moves.rest: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status conditions.
moves.rock-slide: Large boulders are hurled at the opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.
moves.hyper-fang: The user bites hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.sharpen: The user makes its edges more jagged, which raises its Attack stat.
moves.gust: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.
moves.conversion: The user changes its type to become the same type as the move at the top of the list of moves it knows.
moves.tri-attack: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. May also burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.
moves.super-fang: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This cuts the target’s HP in half.
moves.slash: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades. Critical hits land more easily.
moves.substitute: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.
moves.sketch: It enables the user to permanently learn the move last used by the target. Once used, Sketch disappears.
moves.triple-kick: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successive hit.
moves.thief: The user attacks and steals the target’s held item simultaneously. The user can’t steal anything if it already holds an item.
moves.spider-web: The user ensnares the target with thin, gooey silk so it can’t flee from battle.
moves.wing-attack: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.
moves.mind-reader: The user senses the target’s movements with its mind to ensure its next attack does not miss the target.
moves.nightmare: A sleeping target sees a nightmare that inflicts some damage every turn.
moves.flame-wheel: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.snore: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.
moves.curse: A move that works differently for the Ghost type than for all other types.
moves.flail: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. The less HP the user has, the greater the move’s power.
moves.conversion-2: The user changes its type to make itself resistant to the type of the attack the opponent used last.
moves.aeroblast: A vortex of air is shot at the target to inflict damage. Critical hits land more easily.
moves.cotton-spore: The user releases cotton-like spores that cling to the opposing Pokémon, which harshly lowers their Speed stat.
moves.reversal: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
moves.whirlwind: The target is blown away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
moves.spite: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.
moves.powder-snow: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. This may also freeze the opposing Pokémon.
moves.protect: Enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
moves.mach-punch: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. This move always goes first.
moves.scary-face: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.
moves.feint-attack: The user approaches the target disarmingly, then throws a sucker punch. This attack never misses.
moves.sweet-kiss: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.
moves.belly-drum: The user maximizes its Attack stat in exchange for HP equal to half its max HP.
moves.sludge-bomb: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may also poison the target.
moves.mud-slap: The user hurls mud in the target’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.
moves.fly: The user soars and then strikes its target on the next turn.
moves.octazooka: The user attacks by spraying ink in the target’s face or eyes. This may also lower the target’s accuracy.
moves.spikes: The user lays a trap of spikes at the opposing team’s feet. The trap hurts Pokémon that switch into battle.
moves.zap-cannon: The user fires an electric blast like a cannon to inflict damage and cause paralysis.
moves.foresight: Enables a Ghost-type target to be hit by Normal- and Fighting-type attacks. This also enables an evasive target to be hit.
moves.destiny-bond: After using this move, if the user faints, the Pokémon that landed the knockout hit also faints. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
moves.perish-song: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.
moves.icy-wind: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers the opposing Pokémon’s Speed stats.
moves.detect: Enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
moves.bone-rush: The user strikes the target with a hard bone two to five times in a row.
moves.lock-on: The user takes sure aim at the target. This ensures the next attack does not miss the target.
moves.karate-chop: The target is attacked with a sharp chop. Critical hits land more easily.
moves.bind: Things such as long bodies or tentacles are used to bind and squeeze the target for four to five turns.
moves.outrage: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
moves.sandstorm: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except the Rock, Ground, and Steel types. It raises the Sp. Def stat of Rock types.
moves.giga-drain: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
moves.endure: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
moves.charm: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers its Attack stat.
moves.rollout: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes more powerful each time it hits.
moves.false-swipe: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.
moves.swagger: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply raises the target’s Attack stat.
moves.milk-drink: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its max HP.
moves.spark: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.slam: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, or the like to inflict damage.
moves.fury-cutter: The target is slashed with scythes or claws. This attack becomes more powerful if it hits in succession.
moves.steel-wing: The target is hit with wings of steel. This may also raise the user’s Defense stat.
moves.mean-look: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.
moves.attract: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.
moves.sleep-talk: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.
moves.heal-bell: The user makes a soothing bell chime to heal the status conditions of all the party Pokémon.
moves.return: This full-power attack grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.
moves.present: The user attacks by giving the target a gift with a hidden trap. It restores HP sometimes, however.
moves.frustration: This full-power attack grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.
moves.safeguard: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.
moves.vine-whip: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.
moves.pain-split: The user adds its HP to the target’s HP, then equally shares the combined HP with the target.
moves.sacred-fire: The target is razed with a mystical fire of great intensity. This may also leave the target with a burn.
moves.magnitude: The user attacks everything around it with a ground-shaking quake. Its power varies.
moves.dynamic-punch: The user punches the target with full, concentrated power. This confuses the target if it hits.
moves.megahorn: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.
moves.dragon-breath: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
moves.baton-pass: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.
moves.encore: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.
moves.pursuit: The power of this attack move is doubled if it’s used on a target that’s switching out of battle.
moves.rapid-spin: A spin attack that can also eliminate such moves as Bind, Wrap, Leech Seed, and Spikes.
moves.stomp: The target is stomped with a big foot. This may also make the target flinch.
moves.sweet-scent: A sweet scent that harshly lowers opposing Pokémon’s evasiveness.
moves.iron-tail: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.
moves.metal-claw: The target is raked with steel claws. This may also raise the user’s Attack stat.
moves.vital-throw: The user attacks last. In return, this throw move never misses.
moves.morning-sun: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
moves.synthesis: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
